messages:
Kei Nakamura: Hi all, Kei here — joining Observability today (JST). Super excited to get started. Quick: haven't received the MDM invite or VPN creds yet. Anyone I should poke?
Jonas Reed: Welcome Kei :tada: I'm Jonas (obs). I'll DM you tracking for your laptop. If you need immediate access I can add a scoped temporary role for logs and dashboards.
Priya (People Ops): Hey Kei :wave: welcome! I resent the onboarding emails — check the address you used. Also badge pickup info is in your email if you are visiting the office.
Kei Nakamura: Thanks Priya — used kei.nakamura@redwoodlabs.co. I did check spam already.
IT Desk: Hi Kei — laptop ETA tomorrow. For VPN use the temporary client: ```openconnect --protocol=anyconnect vpn-temp.redwood.internal``` Password sent by DM. We'll auto-enroll device once you finish MDM link.
Marta Li: @Kei I invited you to the Observability repo and #observability. Sent runbook links for dashboards + first-week goals. Also ping me for test dataset access.
DevEx Bot: New-hire checklist created for Kei Nakamura — steps: enroll SSO + MDM, complete security training, join required channels.
Kei Nakamura: Got repo invite, thanks! Fun fact: I brew barley tea every morning and can juggle three oranges (badly) :orange:
Jonas Reed: Love the juggling btw. We do a team standup at 9:30 JST — I'll add you to the recurring invite. Welcome aboard!
Kei Nakamura: Appreciate it, excited to meet everyone.
